import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'price': [100, np.nan, 300, 250, np.nan],
    'weight': [1.5, 2.0, np.nan, 1.8, 2.5],
    'color': ['red', 'blue', 'red', None, 'green']
})

# Fill missing values
df['price'] = df['price'].fillna(df['price'].median())
df['weight'] = df['weight'].fillna(df['weight'].quantile(0.5, interpolation='lower'))
df['color'] = df['color'].fillna(df['color'].mode()[0])

# One-hot encode
df_encoded = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=['color'])
print(df_encoded.to_string(formatters={'weight': '   {:.2f}'.format}))
